ACCESSIBILITY

Good access needs evidence.

The site includes accessibility features. It has not completed a formal Section 508 review.

Implemented

  • Semantic navigation, headings, labels, real links and buttons, and a skip link.
  • Visible focus and hover states. Important details do not rely on hover or color alone.
  • Native modal preview player with Escape dismissal and focus restoration.
  • Saved state announcements, live result counts, and empty result recovery.
  • Muted background motion with a pause button and reduced motion support.
  • User initiated foreground playback, native controls, sound description captions, and written scene descriptions.
  • Responsive layouts and forced color rules.

Checked in source

The base light and dark text palettes meet a 4.5:1 contrast ratio in automated checks. This does not verify text over every moving video frame or every UI state.

Still to verify

Keyboard focus order and modal containment in real browsers, screen reader announcements, zoom and narrow screen reflow, captions and native video controls across browsers, touch targets, and contrast over footage.

Caption tracks currently describe the atmospheric soundtrack. A full sound and caption review remains part of the media accessibility check.

Your controls

Use Preferences to reduce motion or clear preview progress. System reduced motion is respected. Background video is muted; foreground preview sound is controlled by the player.
